announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift now supports direct writes to Apache Iceberg tables through the AWS Glue Data Catalog mount and adds ALTER TABLE functionality for modifying Iceberg table schemas, partitioning, and properties. This enhancement allows users to write Redshift transformations directly to their data lake without creating external schemas, making the data accessible to any query engine. The feature is particularly beneficial for Iceberg tables integrated with AWS Lake Formation.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Studio now supports GPU capacity reservation through SageMaker Flexible Training Plans
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Studio IDEs (JupyterLab and Code Editor) now support GPU capacity reservations through SageMaker Flexible Training Plans (FTP), providing predictable access to high-performance computing resources. This new feature offers up to 65% cost savings compared to On-Demand instances while ensuring reliable GPU availability for ML workflows within budget constraints.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs announces increased query result limits
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Logs has increased its query result limits from 10,000 to 100,000 results for Logs Insights queries. This enhancement eliminates the need for customers to split queries into smaller time ranges and allows them to use features like patterns, visualization, and export on the expanded result set.

announcements.title: Amazon EMR Serverless is now available in additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EMR Serverless has expanded its availability to six additional AWS Regions across Asia Pacific (Hyderabad, Malaysia, New Zealand, Taipei, and Thailand) and Mexico (Central). EMR Serverless is a deployment option that enables data engineers and analysts to run petabyte-scale data analytics using Apache Spark and Apache Hive applications in a simple and cost-effective manner without managing infrastructure.

announcements.title: AWS Partner Central agents now accelerates opportunity creation
announcements.summary: AWS has announced that AWS Partner Central agents now enable partners to create opportunities through natural language conversations instead of filling out complex multi-step forms. These AI-powered agents, built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, help partners identify pipeline insights, advance deals with recommendations, and find funding opportunities. The update streamlines the opportunity creation process by allowing partners to simply have a conversation with the AI agent.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Cases now lets you edit related items and delete cases from the agent workspace
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Cases now allows agents to directly edit and delete related items and cases from their workspace without requiring administrator assistance. Agents can update comments, unlink incorrectly associated contacts, delete erroneous cases, and manage custom related items like orders and returns. This feature is available in US East (N. Virginia) and US West (Oregon) AWS regions.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL announces Extended Support minor versions 11.22-rds.20260224, 12.22-rds.20260224, and 13.23-rds.20260224
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL has released new Extended Support minor versions (11.22-rds.20260224, 12.22-rds.20260224, and 13.23-rds.20260224) that include critical security and bug fixes. AWS recommends upgrading to these versions to address known vulnerabilities in previous PostgreSQL versions. Amazon RDS Extended Support provides up to three additional years of security updates beyond the standard support end date for major versions.

announcements.title: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports in-place upgrade to Grafana version 12.4
announcements.summary: Amazon Managed Grafana now supports easy in-place upgrades from version 10.4 to 12.4 through the AWS Console, SDK, or CLI. The upgrade introduces native Grafana Scenes-powered dashboards for improved performance, queryless Drilldown apps for exploring Prometheus metrics and other observability data, and enhanced CloudWatch plugin capabilities with PPL/SQL query support.

announcements.title: AWS Organizations now supports higher quotas for service control policies (SCPs)
announcements.summary: AWS Organizations has increased service control policy (SCP) quotas, doubling both the maximum number of SCPs that can be attached to a single node (from 5 to 10) and the maximum SCP size (from 5,120 to 10,240 characters). These enhanced limits enable organizations to create more detailed permissions and comprehensive security controls across their AWS infrastructure.

announcements.title: AWS announces AWS Interconnect - multicloud connectivity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure in preview
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the public preview of AWS Interconnect, a new service that provides multicloud connectivity with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). This service addresses the growing customer demand for multicloud strategies by enabling easier interconnection of workloads across multiple cloud environments. The solution aims to give customers greater flexibility in choosing technologies and deploying applications across different cloud platforms with improved interoperability.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront announces support for OCSP Revocation for Mutual TLS (Viewer)
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront now supports Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) revocation checking for mutual TLS (mTLS), allowing real-time validation of client certificate revocation status during connection establishment. This enhancement enables customers to verify that client certificates haven't been revoked before accepting connections, addressing key security requirements for regulated industries and zero-trust architectures.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock Introduces Advanced Prompt Optimization and Migration Tool
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock has launched Advanced Prompt Optimization, a new tool designed to help customers quickly optimize and migrate prompts between models without spending days or weeks on manual testing. The tool includes built-in evaluations to prevent regressions and improve performance on underperforming tasks. This addresses a key pain point for customers who previously struggled with efficiently testing and refining prompts when switching models or seeking better performance.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront announces Passthrough Mode for mutual TLS (Viewer)
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront has introduced a new "passthrough mode" for mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication that allows client certificates to be forwarded directly to origin servers for validation, bypassing CloudFront's certificate verification. This feature enables customers with existing mTLS implementations at their origins to use CloudFront without needing to redesign their certificate validation logic for edge processing. The passthrough mode joins the existing required and optional mTLS modes already available in CloudFront.

announcements.title: Announcing general availability of Amazon EC2 M3 Ultra Mac instances
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 M3 Ultra Mac instances, which are powered by the latest Mac Studio hardware and represent the next generation of EC2 Mac instances. These instances are specifically designed for Apple developers to run demanding build and test workloads on AWS for applications across Apple platforms including iOS, macOS, iPadOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and Safari.

announcements.title: SageMaker AI now supports serverless model customization for Qwen3.6
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI has added serverless model customization support for Alibaba Cloud's Qwen3.6 27B parameter model, allowing users to fine-tune it using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT). This builds on existing support for Qwen3.5 and other models, expanding beyond just deployment to enable customization for specific domains and workflows.

announcements.title: AWS Transform agents now available in Kiro, Claude, Cursor, and Codex
announcements.summary: AWS has announced that its Transform agents, which leverage AWS's extensive migration and modernization expertise, are now available through multiple platforms including Kiro, agent plugins, and the AWS Transform MCP server. This integration allows developers to access AWS Transform capabilities directly from their preferred development environments, whether through agentic IDEs, web consoles, or programmatic integration. The launch aims to provide developers with greater flexibility in how they consume AWS Transform services.

announcements.title: AWS Transform introduces the agent builder toolkit Kiro power for building customized transformation agents
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Kiro power, an agent builder toolkit that is part of the AWS Transform composability initiative. The toolkit allows AWS Partners and customers to build customized transformation agents tailored to their specific modernization needs that integrate seamlessly with AWS Transform. This enables Migration and Modernization Competency Partners, ISVs, and customers to create differentiated transformation solutions for their unique requirements.

announcements.title: AWS Transform now supports customer-owned artifact stores
announcements.summary: AWS Transform, an AI-powered platform for enterprise assessment, migration, and modernization, now supports customer-owned Amazon S3 buckets for storing transformation artifacts. This new feature gives customers complete control over artifact storage location and security, including the ability to use their own AWS KMS keys for encryption and manage custom access policies.

announcements.title: New models for image generation and text embeddings are now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the availability of two new foundation models in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: FLUX.2-klein-base-4B for image generation from Black Forest Labs, and Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B for multilingual text embeddings from Qwen. These models enable AWS customers to build creative AI applications and intelligent search systems with state-of-the-art capabilities on AWS infrastructure.

announcements.title: ARC Region switch adds Lambda event source mapping execution block for event handling during failover
announcements.summary: AWS has announced a new Lambda event source mapping execution block feature for Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) Region Switch. This feature automates the coordinated failover of event streams for multi-Region workloads, helping customers running event-driven architectures achieve faster recovery times during regional outages. The enhancement specifically helps orchestrate Lambda function failovers that process event streams from services like Kinesis during disaster recovery scenarios.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports change data capture (Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL now offers change data capture (CDC) in preview, allowing real-time streaming of database changes directly to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. This fully managed feature automatically captures insert, update, and delete operations as change events, eliminating the need for custom streaming pipelines and simplifying the development of event-driven applications and real-time analytics.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent now available for IAM Identity Center domains
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Data Agent is now available for SageMaker Unified Studio domains configured with IAM Identity Center, extending AI-powered capabilities to data analysts and engineers. The tool allows users to describe analysis goals in plain English and automatically generates working Python or SQL code, eliminating the need to manually write complex queries, joins, and aggregations across SageMaker notebooks and Query Editor environments.

announcements.title: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS now supports creating Multi-AZ file systems in shared VPCs
announcements.summary: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS now supports creating Multi-AZ file systems in shared VPCs, enabling organizations to decentralize network and storage administration more effectively. This enhancement allows participant accounts in an AWS organization to create and manage FSx file systems in VPC subnets that have been shared by owner accounts.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances with Oracle SE2 License Included
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports M8i and R8i instances with Oracle Database Standard Edition 2 (SE2) License Included, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances deliver up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generation Intel-based instances.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda supports scheduled scaling for functions on Lambda Managed Instances
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda now supports scheduled scaling for functions running on Lambda Managed Instances through Amazon EventBridge Scheduler. This feature enables you to set up one-time or recurring schedules that automatically adjust your function's capacity limits before anticipated traffic spikes. The capability helps optimize both performance during peak periods and costs during low-traffic times.

announcements.title: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler adds 619 new SDK API actions, including Lambda Managed Instances
announcements.summary: Amazon EventBridge Scheduler has expanded its AWS SDK integrations by adding 619 new API actions across 13 additional services, including support for AWS Lambda Managed Instances. This serverless scheduler now enables direct invocation of a broader range of AWS services without requiring custom integration code, allowing users to create and manage billions of scheduled events across over 270 AWS services.

announcements.title: AWS Security Agent now supports full repository code reviews
announcements.summary: AWS has released a new full repository code review capability for AWS Security Agent that performs comprehensive, context-aware security analysis of entire codebases. Unlike traditional static analysis tools that rely on pattern matching, this feature analyzes application architecture, trust boundaries, and data flows to identify systemic vulnerabilities that other tools might miss. The scanner provides detailed vulnerability reports when issues are detected.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store now supports SageMaker Python SDK V3
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Feature Store now supports the SageMaker Python SDK v3, bringing new capabilities for Lake Formation access controls and Apache Iceberg table properties configuration. The updated SDK provides data scientists with modern, modular interfaces to manage feature groups with fine-grained access control and optimized offline storage. This enhancement improves the management of the fully managed repository used for storing, sharing, and managing machine learning model features.

announcements.title: Karpenter now supports Amazon Application Recovery Controller zonal shift
announcements.summary: Amazon EKS now supports Amazon Application Recovery Controller (ARC) zonal shift and zonal autoshift when using Karpenter for compute provisioning. This integration allows Kubernetes applications to automatically shift network traffic away from impaired Availability Zones, improving application availability and recovery coordination across AWS Regions and AZs.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift launches RG instances powered by AWS Graviton
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift has launched RG instances, a new generation of provisioned cluster nodes powered by AWS Graviton processors that deliver up to 2.4x faster performance than previous RA3 instances at 30% lower cost per vCPU. These instances include Redshift's custom vectorized query engine that can process Apache Iceberg and Parquet data directly on cluster nodes, enabling SQL analytics across both data warehouse and data lake workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront Premium flat-rate plan now supports configurable usage allowances
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront has updated its Premium flat-rate plan to offer multiple configurable usage tiers, ranging from 500 million to 6 billion requests and 50 TB to 600 TB monthly. This replaces the previous single-tier system and allows customers to scale self-service without needing to contact AWS for custom pricing. The change makes flat-rate plans accessible to enterprises and mid-sized businesses that were previously ineligible due to higher baseline traffic requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports embedding Cases and Customer Profiles in custom agent applications
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now allows developers to embed Cases and Customer Profiles directly into custom agent applications using the Amazon Connect SDK. This integration enables agents to access customer context and case information within their existing tools, streamlining issue resolution workflows. The SDK is available in all AWS Regions where Amazon Connect Customer operates, eliminating the need for developers to build these capabilities from scratch.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of P6-B200 instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 P6-B200 instances in the US East (N. Virginia) region for SageMaker Studio notebooks. These instances are powered by 8 NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs with 1440 GB of GPU memory and 5th Generation Intel Xeon processors, delivering up to 2x better performance than P5en instances for AI training. Customers can use these high-performance instances to develop and fine-tune large foundation models interactively.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of G6e instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 G6e instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks in six additional regions: Middle East (Dubai), Asia Pacific (Tokyo, Seoul), and Europe (Frankfurt, Stockholm, Spain). These instances feature up to 8 NVIDIA L40s Tensor Core GPUs with 48 GB memory per GPU and third-generation AMD EPYC processors, delivering up to 2.5x better performance than G5 instances. The G6e instances enable customers to interactively test model deployments with enhanced GPU capabilities.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of G6 instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Amazon EC2 G6 instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks in the Middle East (Dubai) and Asia Pacific (Malaysia) regions. These instances are powered by up to 8 NVIDIA L4 Tensor Core GPUs with 24 GB memory per GPU and third-generation AMD EPYC processors, delivering 2x better deep learning inference performance compared to G4dn instances. Customers can use G6 instances for interactive model deployment testing and development work.

announcements.title: Announcing Region Expansion of P4de instances on SageMaker Studio notebooks
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded the availability of Amazon EC2 P4de instances to Asia Pacific (Tokyo, Singapore) and Europe (Frankfurt) regions on SageMaker Studio notebooks. These instances feature 8 NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 80GB memory each (640GB total), offering double the GPU memory of P4d instances. P4de instances deliver up to 60% better ML training performance and 20% lower training costs compared to the previous P4d generation.

announcements.title: ENA Express for Amazon EC2 instances now supports traffic between Availability Zones
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded ENA Express support to enable traffic between EC2 instances across different Availability Zones within a region, delivering up to 25 Gbps single-flow bandwidth. ENA Express uses AWS's Scalable Reliable Datagram (SRD) protocol to improve network performance through advanced congestion control and multi-pathing. This enhancement extends the high-performance networking capabilities beyond instances within the same Availability Zone to cross-AZ communications.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL is now available in five additional AWS Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL, AWS's fastest serverless distributed SQL database, has expanded availability to five new regions: Asia Pacific (Hong Kong, Mumbai, Singapore), Europe (Stockholm), and South America (Sao Paulo). Aurora DSQL provides unlimited scalability, high availability, and zero infrastructure management for building always-available applications.

announcements.title: AWS HealthOmics now supports caching of cancelled workflow runs
announcements.summary: AWS HealthOmics now supports caching of completed task outputs from cancelled workflow runs, allowing customers to restart from the point of cancellation without recomputing previously finished tasks. When caching is enabled, completed outputs are automatically stored in the customer's S3 bucket for reuse. This feature helps healthcare and life sciences customers avoid redundant computation and accelerate their scientific workflows.

announcements.title: AWS WAF introduces dynamic label interpolation for custom request and response handling
announcements.summary: AWS WAF now supports dynamic label interpolation, allowing security engineers to use a single rule with ${namespace:} syntax to forward entire label namespaces to origins and embed context in responses. This eliminates the need to maintain separate rules for every signal value, significantly simplifying WAF configuration. For example, one rule with a dynamic variable can now forward all IP reputation signals to an application instead of requiring multiple individual rules.

announcements.title: Claude Platform on AWS is now generally available
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of Claude Platform on AWS, making AWS the first cloud provider to offer direct access to Anthropic's native Claude Platform experience through existing AWS accounts. This new service provides developers and organizations with access to Claude's APIs, console, and early-access beta features directly within their AWS environment.

announcements.title: AWS Transform adds containerization capability during migrations
announcements.summary: AWS Transform has added containerization capabilities that allow organizations to replatform applications to containers during migration to AWS. The service uses agentic AI to automate the containerization of source code from various repositories (GitHub, Bitbucket, GitLab) or zip files, enabling simultaneous migration and modernization. This new feature reduces the time and complexity of transitioning from on-premises infrastructure to cloud-native architectures by combining migration and containerization into a single automated process.

announcements.title: AWS Client VPN now supports Ubuntu OS version 26.04 LTS
announcements.summary: AWS Client VPN now supports Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, expanding its Linux desktop client compatibility to include the latest Ubuntu version. The free desktop client allows secure connections for remote workforces to AWS or on-premises networks. AWS Client VPN already supports macOS, Windows, and other Ubuntu-Linux versions.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect adds default Step-by-Step Guides for After Contact Work
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect now automatically launches Step-by-Step Guides when agents enter After Contact Work (ACW) state, eliminating the need for manual activation. This feature helps contact centers standardize post-contact workflows and reduce handle time by automatically guiding agents through required wrap-up tasks like logging disposition codes and updating cases.

announcements.title: Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver now lets you add and remove AWS Regions for anycast DNS resolution
announcements.summary: Amazon Route 53 Global Resolver now allows users to dynamically add and remove AWS Regions for anycast DNS resolution, providing flexible control over DNS query locations. This enhancement enables organizations to easily scale their DNS coverage as they grow and adjust regional deployments to meet compliance requirements. The feature maintains Global Resolver's core capabilities of anycast DNS resolution for both public and private domains, along with DNS filtering and centralized logging.

announcements.title: AWS Service Catalog is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) and Canada West (Calgary) regions
announcements.summary: AWS Service Catalog is now available in two new regions: Asia Pacific (New Zealand) and Canada West (Calgary). This service allows customers to create and manage catalogs of approved Infrastructure as Code (IaC) products that can be deployed on AWS using tools like CloudFormation or Terraform.

announcements.title: IAM Policy Autopilot adds Java support and Terraform-aware policy generation
announcements.summary: AWS has expanded its open-source IAM Policy Autopilot tool to support Java applications and Terraform-aware policy generation, adding to its existing language coverage. The tool, launched at re:Invent 2025, automatically generates baseline IAM policies from code to help developers create less permissive policies and reduce time spent on policy creation and access troubleshooting.

announcements.title: Amazon Route 53 Resolver endpoints now support additional capabilities for IPv6 query traffic
announcements.summary: Amazon Route 53 Resolver endpoints now support DNS64 on inbound endpoints and IPv6 forwarding through internet gateways on outbound endpoints, simplifying hybrid DNS management across IPv4 and IPv6 networks. The DNS64 feature allows IPv6-only on-premises clients to access IPv4 AWS services by automatically synthesizing IPv6 responses for IPv4-only domains. These enhancements make it easier to integrate mixed IPv4/IPv6 environments without requiring changes to existing services.

announcements.title: AWS Marketplace introduces Tax management portal for sellers
announcements.summary: AWS Marketplace has launched a new Tax management portal that allows sellers to independently view and download invoices through a self-service process, eliminating the need to contact support. The portal is integrated into the AWS Partner Central console and provides centralized access to both seller listing fee invoices and buyer invoices for applicable regions. This streamlines invoice management and record-keeping for marketplace sellers.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 G6 instances now available in AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany)
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 G6 instances powered by NVIDIA L4 GPUs in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud (Germany). These instances are designed to handle graphics-intensive workloads and machine learning applications including natural language processing, computer vision, speech recognition, and graphics rendering. The availability expands AWS's GPU compute options for customers requiring data sovereignty in the European region.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in Europe (Ireland) and Asia Pacific (Mumbai) regions, powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These SAP-certified instances deliver up to 43% higher performance, 1.5x more memory capacity (up to 6TB), and 3.3x more memory bandwidth compared to previous generations, offering the highest performance among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio adds identity and user management features
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio has introduced new administration features that give administrators enhanced control over identity configuration and user management for both IAM and Identity Center domains. In IAM domains, administrators can now onboard users through single sign-on by configuring AWS IAM Identity Center and can add various types of users (IAM roles, users, Identity Center users and groups) as project members. These updates improve team collaboration capabilities within the platform.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 G7e instances now available in Europe (London) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 G7e instances powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs are now available in the Europe (London) region. These instances deliver up to 2.3x better inference performance compared to G6e instances and are optimized for deploying large language models, agentic AI, multimodal generative AI, and physical AI models. G7e instances provide the highest performance for spatial computing and hybrid graphics-compute workloads.

announcements.title: AWS Capabilities by Region now supports availability notifications
announcements.summary: AWS has launched availability notifications for AWS Capabilities by Region, a subscription-based system that automatically alerts developers when specific AWS services or features become available in their target regions. This new feature helps builders track the availability of over 1,500 services and features across 37 AWS regions, streamlining infrastructure planning and deployment decisions.

announcements.title: AWS Elemental MediaTailor launches Monetization Functions
announcements.summary: AWS Elemental MediaTailor has introduced monetization functions, a new feature that allows customers to customize ad decision server (ADS) requests and manage session data during ad-personalized video playback. This capability enables customers to call external APIs and perform data transformations directly within the playback session, removing the need for middleware between the player and ADS. The feature streamlines ad monetization workflows by providing built-in customization points for common use cases like resolving hashed email addresses.

announcements.title: AWS Advanced JDBC Wrapper now provides client-side encryption
announcements.summary: AWS has added client-side encryption capabilities to its Advanced JDBC Wrapper through a new KMS Encryption plugin, allowing Java applications to encrypt sensitive data at the column level before it reaches Amazon Aurora and RDS databases. This feature works without requiring application code changes and complements the wrapper's existing advanced capabilities like failover handling and AWS authentication integration. The client-side encryption provides an additional security layer beyond the standard database encryption at rest and TLS in transit protections.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports AMI-based node lifecycle configuration for Slurm clusters
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports AMI-based configuration for Slurm clusters, eliminating the need to manually download, configure, or upload lifecycle scripts to S3. This streamlined approach significantly reduces cluster creation time by provisioning nodes with pre-configured software and settings for production-ready AI/ML training environments.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 M8gn and M8gb instances are now available in AWS Europe (Ireland) region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 M8gn and M8gb instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors are now available in the Europe (Ireland) region, delivering up to 30% better compute performance than Graviton3 processors. The M8gn instances offer up to 600 Gbps network bandwidth (the highest among network-optimized EC2 instances), while M8gb instances provide up to 300 Gbps of EBS bandwidth.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Outbound Campaigns adds multi-contact time zone detection
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Outbound Campaigns has enhanced its time zone detection to analyze all phone numbers and addresses in a customer profile, rather than just the primary contact information. When multiple time zones are detected for a single customer, the system now only makes calls during hours that fall within the configured window for all detected time zones. This improvement helps ensure compliance with calling time restrictions for customers who have contact information spanning multiple geographic regions.

announcements.title: AWS India customers can now use UPI Scan and Pay for sign-up and payments
announcements.summary: AWS now allows customers in India to use UPI (Unified Payments Interface) Scan and Pay for account sign-ups and invoice payments. The new feature enables customers to simply scan a QR code in the AWS Console with popular UPI mobile apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or Amazon Pay for instant bank-to-bank transfers.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 R8idn and R8idb instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 R8idn and R8idb instances powered by custom sixth-generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors and AWS Nitro cards. These new instances deliver up to 43% better compute performance per vCPU compared to previous R6in generation instances, with R8idn instances offering up to 600 Gbps network bandwidth.

announcements.title: AWS Site-to-Site VPN now supports modifying tunnel bandwidth on existing VPN connections
announcements.summary: AWS Site-to-Site VPN now allows users to modify tunnel bandwidth between standard (up to 1.25 Gbps) and large (up to 5 Gbps) on existing connections without recreating them. Previously, bandwidth changes required deleting and recreating the entire connection, which generated new IP addresses and required updates to on-premises configurations. This enhancement simplifies bandwidth scaling while preserving existing tunnel configurations.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 P6-B300 instances are now available in the US East (N. Virginia) Region, featuring 8x NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs with 2.1 TB of GPU memory and high-performance networking capabilities. These instances offer significant improvements over P6-B200 instances, including 2x networking bandwidth, 1.5x GPU memory size, and 1.5x GPU TFLOPS performance, making them ideal for training and deploying AI models.

announcements.title: AWS Marketplace now supports programmatic procurement with Agreements API
announcements.summary: AWS Marketplace has launched the Agreements API, which allows organizations to programmatically procure products and manage agreements through their existing tools and workflows. The API enables users to generate estimates, accept offers, track charges and entitlements, and update purchase orders automatically. When combined with the existing Discovery API, it provides a complete end-to-end procurement solution from product discovery through purchase.

announcements.title: Amazon Neptune now supports 1-click connect with CloudShell
announcements.summary: Amazon Neptune has launched a 1-click connect feature that allows users to quickly connect to Neptune Database and Neptune Analytics directly through CloudShell. This eliminates the need for manual network configuration and access permission setup that previously required time-consuming effort from database administrators, developers, and data analysts. Users can now immediately start querying their graph databases without any manual network configuration steps.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory announces metadata for long-term memory
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory has added metadata support for long-term memory records, allowing agents to tag, filter, and retrieve memories using structured attributes in addition to semantic search. Users can define up to ten indexed keys per memory resource (supporting STRING, NUMBER, and STRING_LIST types) and apply various operators to filter results. Metadata can be manually attached during ingestion or automatically extracted by the LLM based on provided instructions.

announcements.title: AWS Elastic Beanstalk now supports TLS listeners for Network Load Balancers
announcements.summary: AWS Elastic Beanstalk now supports TLS listeners for Network Load Balancer environments, allowing you to configure SSL certificates and security policies directly through the console or CLI. This enables the load balancer to handle secure connections and forward decrypted traffic to instances. Previously, TLS listeners for NLB environments were not available as a managed configuration option in Elastic Beanstalk.

announcements.title: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now supports ad trickplay personalization and compact DASH manifest optimization via dynamic transcoding
announcements.summary: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now natively supports ad trickplay personalization for HLS and DASH formats, as well as compact DASH manifest optimization, through dynamic transcoding. These enhancements eliminate the previous requirement for custom transcode profiles while improving streaming ad personalization and manifest delivery efficiency. The updates strengthen MediaTailor's server-side ad insertion capabilities for video streaming platforms.

announcements.title: Announcing Agent Toolkit for AWS — help AI coding agents build effectively on AWS
announcements.summary: AWS has launched the Agent Toolkit for AWS, a production-ready suite of tools designed to help AI coding agents build more effectively on AWS infrastructure with reduced errors, lower token costs, and enterprise-grade security. This toolkit replaces the previous MCP servers, plugins, and skills from AWS Labs. It addresses common challenges developers face when using coding agents for AWS development, particularly around complex multi-service workflows and outdated AWS service knowledge.

announcements.title: The AWS MCP Server is now generally available
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of the AWS MCP Server, a managed server that enables AI coding agents to securely access AWS services through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The server is part of the Agent Toolkit for AWS and provides organizations with visibility and control over AI agent interactions through IAM-based security guardrails and Amazon CloudWatch monitoring.

announcements.title: AWS Transfer Family web apps are now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
announcements.summary: AWS Transfer Family web apps are now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region, allowing customers to provide their workforce with a fully managed, branded portal for accessing Amazon S3 data through a web browser. The service offers a simple interface for browsing, uploading, and downloading files securely without requiring technical expertise or additional infrastructure management.

announcements.title: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now provides automatic secure server-to-server integration with Google's ad platforms
announcements.summary: AWS Elemental MediaTailor now offers automatic authentication for server-to-server connections with Google's advertising platforms including Ad Manager, Campaign Manager, and Display & Video 360. This enhancement provides seamless integration for customers using Google's ad platforms with MediaTailor's server-side ad insertion (SSAI) service, which personalizes ads in video streams.

announcements.title: AWS SAM CLI adds BuildKit support for AWS Lambda functions packaged as container images
announcements.summary: AWS SAM CLI now supports BuildKit for building container images from Dockerfiles, enabling faster and more efficient builds for Lambda functions packaged as container images. This enhancement provides developers with advanced build features when creating containerized Lambda functions locally before deploying to AWS Cloud.

announcements.title: AWS SAM now supports WebSocket APIs for Amazon API Gateway
announcements.summary: AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM) now supports WebSocket APIs for Amazon API Gateway, allowing developers to define complete WebSocket APIs with minimal configuration in their SAM templates. This new feature eliminates the need for manual setup when building real-time applications such as chat systems, live dashboards, AI/LLM streaming, and IoT applications. The enhancement makes it easier to build and manage serverless applications that require real-time communication capabilities.

announcements.title: Amazon ElastiCache adds thirteen new Amazon CloudWatch metrics for network capacity planning and engine diagnostics
announcements.summary: Amazon ElastiCache has introduced thirteen new CloudWatch metrics that enable customers to monitor network throttling, memory fragmentation, and connection exhaustion for node-based clusters. These metrics provide host-level and engine-level diagnostics directly through CloudWatch, eliminating the need to run INFO commands on individual nodes or manually calculate baselines from raw data. The new metrics cover network capacity monitoring, memory diagnostics, and connection tracking to improve cluster performance management.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces now lets AI agents operate desktop applications (Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces now supports AI agents operating desktop applications in a preview feature, allowing organizations to automate workflows involving legacy systems like mainframes and ERP tools that lack modern APIs. This addresses the "last-mile challenge" where AI agents previously couldn't interact with critical business applications that only have desktop interfaces. The solution maintains enterprise-grade security and governance while enabling large-scale automation of everyday business processes.

announcements.title: AWS IoT Core for Device Location adds Confidence Level Configuration and Measurement Type support
announcements.summary: AWS IoT Core for Device Location has added two new enhancements for developers: the ability to specify confidence levels between 50-99% for location accuracy, and support for richer metadata in resolved device locations. The confidence level feature works with Cell ID, Wi-Fi, and Cell+Wi-Fi solvers and represents the statistical probability that a device's actual location falls within the reported accuracy radius. These updates provide developers with greater control over location resolution and more detailed location information.

announcements.title: Amazon MQ now supports in-place major version upgrades for RabbitMQ 4
announcements.summary: Amazon MQ now supports in-place major version upgrades that allow users to upgrade RabbitMQ brokers from version 3.13 to 4.2 directly through the console, CLI, or API without creating new brokers or migrating data. The upgrade process preserves all broker configurations, queues, exchanges, bindings, users, and policies, though RabbitMQ 4.2 includes breaking changes such as the removal of classic mirrored queues.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick now integrates with New Relic for observability-driven AI agents
announcements.summary: Amazon Quick has integrated with New Relic's AI agents through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, allowing engineers to perform incident investigation, root cause analysis, and task creation directly within their Quick workspace. This integration enables on-call engineers, SREs, and engineering leaders to access New Relic's observability tools—including alert insights, user impact analysis, and log analysis—through conversational prompts without switching platforms.

announcements.title: EC2 Instance Store CSI driver now generally available in EKS add-ons
announcements.summary: AWS has made the EC2 Instance Store CSI driver generally available as an EKS add-on, allowing users to easily install and manage it through the EKS console or AWS CLI. This driver enables Kubernetes clusters to utilize EC2 instance store volumes, which provide ephemeral block-level storage directly attached to EC2 instances. The launch simplifies the process of integrating local instance storage with EKS clusters.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Cases now supports customer profile identity resolution
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Cases now automatically consolidates case histories when duplicate customer profiles are merged through Identity Resolution. When customers have multiple profiles across different channels or contact details, the system detects duplicates, merges them, and brings all associated cases together under a single unified profile. This ensures agents can view complete case histories without manually searching for related cases across different customer profiles.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights supports querying by log group tags
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch Logs Insights now supports querying log groups using tags, allowing customers to analyze logs without explicitly listing log group names. This enhancement enables users to query logs using key-value tag pairs like Environment: Production or Application: PaymentService, making log analysis more flexible and organized.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now supports host-to-client URL redirection
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now supports host-to-client URL redirection, automatically opening URLs from streaming sessions in users' local browsers instead of within the remote session. Administrators can configure allow/deny URL patterns through the AWS Management Console to control which content gets redirected. This feature helps organizations keep sensitive applications secure in the streaming environment while offloading resource-heavy content like videos to local devices for better performance.

announcements.title: AWS Entity Resolution launches support for incremental Machine Learning based matching workflows
announcements.summary: AWS Entity Resolution now supports incremental Machine Learning-based matching workflows, allowing customers to add new records without reprocessing entire datasets. This eliminates a major bottleneck that previously required up to 2 days and thousands of dollars to process even single record additions. The new capability fundamentally transforms how enterprises can efficiently scale their entity resolution processes.

announcements.title: Amazon FSx is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon FSx, AWS's fully-managed file system service, is now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region. The service offers four file system options (NetApp ONTAP, Windows File Server, Lustre, and OpenZFS) and provides a cost-effective solution for launching and scaling high-performance file systems in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick generates dashboards from natural language prompts
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight now offers Generate Analysis, a feature that creates dashboards from natural language descriptions. Users can describe their desired dashboard, select up to three datasets, and QuickSight automatically generates organized sheets with appropriate visuals, filter controls, and calculated fields like year-over-year comparisons. This significantly reduces dashboard creation time from hours of manual configuration to a streamlined automated process.

announcements.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports the JSON data type with compression
announcements.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports the PostgreSQL JSON data type with optional compression, allowing developers to use existing PostgreSQL JSON-dependent code and tools without modification. This feature enables seamless storage of semi-structured data like API payloads, configuration objects, and event logs alongside traditional relational data in Aurora DSQL tables.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick introduces Dataset Q&A for conversational analytics against enterprise data
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight has launched Dataset Q&A, a new conversational analytics feature that allows users to ask natural language questions directly against their enterprise data. This capability, along with the existing Dashboard Q&A, enables anyone with dataset access to explore data and gain insights using plain English while maintaining all security and governance policies. The feature democratizes data analysis by making it accessible through natural language rather than requiring technical query skills.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick now supports S3 tables bucket as a data source
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight now supports S3 table buckets as a direct data source, allowing users to build dashboards and perform analytics on Apache Iceberg tables without requiring intermediate data warehouses or OLAP layers. This integration enables both AI-powered and traditional BI workloads through a simplified lakehouse architecture. The feature works alongside Zero-ETL integrations from sources like Salesforce, SAP, and Kinesis Data Firehose.

announcements.title: Amazon EventBridge supports data plane logging to AWS CloudTrail
announcements.summary: Amazon EventBridge now supports data plane API logging through AWS CloudTrail, giving customers enhanced visibility into event bus activity for improved security monitoring and operational troubleshooting. This new capability allows users to track API activities within their event-driven applications built on EventBridge's serverless event bus platform. The feature helps customers follow security best practices by providing detailed logging of events from AWS services, SaaS applications, and custom sources.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick upgrades the extension for Microsoft Outlook (Preview)
announcements.summary: AWS has announced a preview of the Amazon Quick extension for Microsoft Outlook, which integrates generative AI-powered productivity tools directly into email and calendar workflows. The extension allows users to summarize unread messages, organize their inbox, schedule meetings, and draft responses using natural language commands without leaving Outlook. The tool aims to help users prioritize emails and focus on important tasks by leveraging AI capabilities within their existing email interface.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker AI launches AI agent experience for model customization
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI has launched a new AI agent experience that dramatically reduces model customization time from months to just days or hours. The agentic workflow streamlines the complex process of defining use cases, preparing data, selecting models, and running experiments with various fine-tuning techniques. This enhancement helps customers more efficiently identify suitable model candidates that meet their specific success criteria.

announcements.title: AWS Payment Cryptography announces support for cross account key sharing
announcements.summary: AWS Payment Cryptography now supports cross-account key sharing through resource-based policies (RBP), enabling customers to manage cryptographic keys across multiple AWS accounts within or outside their organization. This enhancement provides greater flexibility for managing keys at scale and simplifies cryptography operations in cloud-hosted payment applications with elastic scalability.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports M8i and R8i instances
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports M8i and R8i instances powered by custom Intel Xeon 6 processors exclusive to AWS. These new instances deliver up to 15% better price-performance and 2.5x more memory bandwidth compared to equivalent 7th generation Intel-based instances, providing the highest performance among comparable Intel processors in the cloud.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is now available in the South America (São Paulo) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, a platform for building, connecting, and optimizing AI agents, is now available in the AWS South America (São Paulo) Region. The service enables engineers to quickly develop agents using any framework and model, integrate them with enterprise systems, and continuously optimize them with built-in security. This regional expansion allows South American customers to deploy agents closer to their end users for improved performance.

announcements.title: FreeRTOS 202604 LTS now available with enhanced security and MQTT v5.0
announcements.summary: AWS has released FreeRTOS 202604 LTS, a new Long Term Support version of the open-source real-time operating system for embedded and IoT devices. This release provides two years of feature stability, security updates, and critical bug fixes, while addressing key embedded systems challenges including memory safety, code quality, and protocol support. The update includes FreeRTOS kernel v11.3.0 with new hardware ports and enhanced security features.

announcements.title: OpenSearch UI supports cross-region data access to OpenSearch domains
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now enables cross-region data access through OpenSearch UI, allowing users to access OpenSearch domains hosted in different AWS regions from a single application interface. Combined with the previously launched cross-account access feature, users can now query and build dashboards across flexible combinations of accounts and regions without switching endpoints or duplicating data. This enhancement eliminates the need for data replication and simplifies multi-region OpenSearch management.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront Announces WebSocket Support for VPC Origins
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront now supports WebSocket traffic for applications hosted in Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) origins, allowing CloudFront to serve as a single entry point for real-time applications in private subnets. This enhancement enables persistent, bidirectional connections for applications like chat platforms, collaborative editing tools, live dashboards, and IoT device management systems that were previously limited when using VPC origins.

announcements.title: IAM Roles Anywhere now enforces VPC endpoint policies for the CreateSession API
announcements.summary: AWS IAM Roles Anywhere now supports VPC endpoint policies for the CreateSession API, allowing administrators to explicitly allow or deny this operation through VPC endpoint policy configuration. If the CreateSession operation is not explicitly included in the Allow statement of a VPC endpoint policy, IAM Roles Anywhere will deny access to the API.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift Introduces Concurrency Scaling Support for auto-copy and zero-ETL
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift has announced general availability of concurrency scaling support for auto-copy and zero-ETL features, which enhances data ingestion performance by combining seamless S3 data ingestion and near real-time database replication with elastic scaling capabilities. This enhancement is designed to benefit high-volume, time-sensitive data processing workloads by providing greater elasticity and performance for data ingestion operations.

announcements.title: AWS Transform now offers BI migration agents for Power BI and Tableau to Amazon Quick
announcements.summary: AWS Transform now provides BI migration agents that can automatically convert Tableau and Power BI dashboards to Amazon QuickSight, reducing migration time from months to just days. These agents were developed by Wavicle Data Solutions, an AWS Advanced Consulting Partner, and leverage AWS Transform's agentic AI capabilities to streamline the business intelligence migration process.

announcements.title: Spatial Data Management on AWS adds custom transformations
announcements.summary: AWS Spatial Data Management (SDMA) now supports custom transformation connectors that enable compute-intensive processing tasks like format conversion, 3D rendering, and image tiling through AWS Deadline Cloud integration. The update also includes a unified desktop client installer and allows users to extend SDMA's built-in content analysis with custom logic for format verification and attribute extraction.

announcements.title: Announcing Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation for Elastic Fabric Adapter
announcements.summary: Amazon EKS now supports Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA) for Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA), which simplifies high-performance networking and RDMA capabilities for AI, ML, and HPC workloads on Kubernetes. The new EFA DRA driver enables interface sharing and topology-aware allocation, making it easier to manage high-performance inter-node communication in Kubernetes clusters.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for SQL Server supports cross-account snapshot sharing with additional storage volumes
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports cross-account snapshot sharing for database instances that use additional storage volumes, which allow customers to scale storage up to 256 TiB by adding up to three 64 TiB volumes. This feature enables customers to create, share, and copy database snapshots across different AWS accounts for these high-capacity database configurations.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for SQL Server supports read replica with additional storage volumes
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for SQL Server now supports read replicas for database instances that use additional storage volumes, which allow customers to scale storage up to 256 TiB by adding up to three additional 64 TiB volumes beyond the primary storage. This enhancement enables customers to create both same-region and cross-region read replicas for these high-storage database instances.

announcements.title: AWS Payment Cryptography now supports paper-based key exchange
announcements.summary: AWS Payment Cryptography has introduced Physical Key Exchange, a new PCI PIN and P2PE compliant feature that enables paper-based cryptographic key exchange without requiring organizations to maintain their own secure key loading infrastructure. This feature helps accelerate migration for customers whose partners or vendors don't support electronic key exchange methods. The service provides managed, elastic key management for payment processing operations.

announcements.title: AWS Outposts racks now support LagStatus CloudWatch metric
announcements.summary: AWS Outposts racks now support the LagStatus CloudWatch metric across all commercial AWS regions and GovCloud regions. This new metric allows customers to monitor their Outposts LAG connectivity status directly within the CloudWatch console, eliminating the need for external networking tools or cross-team coordination. Users can leverage this metric to set up alarms, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and ensure proper rack connectivity.

announcements.title: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now supports NVIDIA GPU metrics
announcements.summary: Amazon ECS Managed Instances now provides NVIDIA GPU metrics for containerized workloads, available through Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights. This enhancement gives customers visibility into GPU health, performance, capacity, utilization, and memory to help optimize and troubleshoot GPU-accelerated workloads running on Amazon ECS.

announcements.title: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ now supports Prometheus metrics
announcements.summary: Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ now includes native Prometheus plugin support on RabbitMQ 4.2 brokers, enabling direct metrics collection through dedicated endpoints. This integration allows users to scrape broker, queue, and connection metrics using any Prometheus-compatible monitoring tool, providing greater flexibility for monitoring and alerting on messaging infrastructure.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports On-Behalf-Of (OBO) token exchange
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports On-Behalf-Of (OBO) token exchange, allowing developers to build agents that can securely access protected resources on behalf of authenticated users without requiring multiple consent flows. This eliminates the previous need for developers to manage separate consent processes for each protected resource, reducing both user friction and development complexity.

announcements.title: AWS Neuron SDK now available with Neuron Agentic Development for NKI kernel development on Trainium
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Neuron Agentic Development, an open-source collection of agents and skills that enable AI coding assistants to accelerate development on AWS Trainium and Inferentia chips. The initial release focuses on Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) kernel development, providing agentic coding capabilities that cover the complete workflow from code authoring to performance profiling and analysis. This gives developers low-level programming access to Trainium for creating custom compute kernels with AI-assisted development tools.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore launches capabilities for optimizing agent performance in preview
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore has launched new preview capabilities including recommendations, batch evaluations, and A/B testing to help developers systematically optimize AI agent performance. These tools complete the "observe, evaluate, improve" cycle for production AI agents, replacing manual developer intervention with a more systematic approach. The new features enable developers to translate evaluation findings into concrete, validated improvements for their AI agents.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda adds support for Ruby 4.0
announcements.summary: AWS Lambda now supports Ruby 4.0 for building serverless applications, offering it as both a managed runtime and container base image with automatic updates. Ruby 4.0 is the latest long-term support (LTS) release that will receive security and bug fixes until March 2029. This addition gives developers access to the newest Ruby language features within the Lambda serverless environment.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick adds Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint extensions and updates the Word extension (Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon Quick has launched preview versions of new Microsoft 365 extensions for Excel, PowerPoint, and an updated Word extension, allowing users to leverage AI directly within their Microsoft Office applications. These extensions enable complex tasks like document redlining, financial modeling, presentation creation, spreadsheet analysis, pivot table generation, and data cleaning without leaving the Microsoft 365 environment.

announcements.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports index-level encryption
announcements.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Service now offers index-level encryption, allowing you to encrypt data at rest on individual indexes using AWS KMS customer managed keys rather than just at the domain level. This enhancement enables you to use different encryption keys for different indexes within the same domain, providing more granular and tenant-specific encryption policies.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for MySQL announces Innovation Release 9.6 in Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for MySQL now supports MySQL Innovation Release 9.6 in the Amazon RDS Database Preview Environment, allowing users to evaluate the latest community MySQL release. This preview environment provides a fully managed database experience, simplifying setup, operation, and monitoring while users test the newest MySQL features and improvements.

announcements.title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is Now Available in the Canada West (Calgary) Region
announcements.summary: Amazon DocumentDB, a fully managed JSON database service with MongoDB compatibility, is now available in the Canada West (Calgary) region. This expansion adds another regional option for customers looking to run critical document workloads at scale without managing infrastructure. The service is designed to provide scalability and durability for mission-critical MongoDB applications.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudFront now supports invalidation by cache tag
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudFront now supports cache tag invalidation, allowing users to remove groups of related cached content from edge locations with a single request instead of invalidating objects individually. This new feature simplifies operational workflows like updating product information across multiple pages, handling legal takedown requests, and managing content refreshes across multi-tenant platforms.

announcements.title: Paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2, Table Transformer Detection, and Bielik-11B-v3.0-Instruct are now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
announcements.summary: AWS has added three new AI models to Amazon SageMaker JumpStart: paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 (a lightweight semantic similarity model supporting 50+ languages), Microsoft Table Transformer Detection, and Bielik-11B-v3.0-Instruct. The multilingual model is particularly useful for finding semantically similar content across different languages by mapping text to a 384-dimensional vector space.

announcements.title: Gemma 4 models are now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
announcements.summary: AWS has announced the availability of three new Gemma 4 models (E4B, 26B-A4B, and 31B) in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, expanding Google DeepMind's foundation model offerings for AWS customers. These instruction-tuned models feature multimodal capabilities, configurable reasoning, native function calling, and support for over 140 languages, enabling customers to build sophisticated AI applications on AWS infrastructure.

announcements.title: Amazon CloudWatch adds visual agent configuration to the EC2 console
announcements.summary: Amazon CloudWatch now offers a visual configuration editor in the EC2 console that allows users to set up and manage the CloudWatch agent without manually editing JSON files. The CloudWatch agent collects metrics, logs, and traces from EC2 instances and sends them to CloudWatch and AWS X-Ray. This new graphical interface enables users to easily build agent configurations by visually selecting metrics, log sources, and deployment targets.

announcements.title: OpenAI GPT OSS and NVIDIA Nemotron Models Available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock now offers OpenAI's open-weight GPT OSS models (120B and 20B parameters) and NVIDIA Nemotron models (ranging from 9B to 120B parameters) in AWS GovCloud (US). This expansion provides government and regulated industry customers access to diverse, high-performance foundation models through a single unified API, enabling them to select the most suitable model for specific generative AI use cases.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick Adds Custom Sort for Filter Controls
announcements.summary: Amazon QuickSight has introduced custom sort functionality for filter controls, allowing authors to control how values are displayed in dropdown and list controls instead of the previous alphabetical-only sorting. This feature enables authors to arrange filter values according to business logic or rank them by related metrics, ensuring the most relevant options appear first. The custom sort feature works with both single-select and multi-select dropdown and list controls, with ascending and descending sort options available.

announcements.title: AWS Transfer Family Terraform module now supports Okta and Microsoft Entra ID integration examples
announcements.summary: AWS Transfer Family's Terraform module now includes complete examples for integrating with Okta and Microsoft Entra ID as custom identity providers for authentication and access control. This enables enterprises to automatically deploy Transfer Family servers that work seamlessly with their existing identity management systems through infrastructure-as-code.

announcements.title: Amazon RDS for Db2 is now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-East, US-West) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon RDS for Db2 is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East and US-West) regions, allowing government customers to easily deploy and manage Db2 databases in the cloud. The service enables quick database deployment with optimized configurations and offers Multi-AZ synchronous replication for high availability across different Availability Zones.

announcements.title: Amazon EMR 7.13 now available with Python 3.11
announcements.summary: Amazon EMR 7.13 is now available with Python 3.11 as the default for Apache Spark, along with updated versions of Apache HBase 2.6.3, Apache Hadoop 3.4.2, Apache Phoenix 5.3.0, and AWS SDK v2.41.11. The release is available in all AWS regions where Amazon EMR is supported.

announcements.title: AWS Glue 5.1 is now available in all AWS Commercial and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: AWS Glue 5.1 is now available across all AWS Commercial and GovCloud regions, including the newly added Asia Pacific (New Zealand) region. The update upgrades core engines to Apache Spark 3.5.6, Python 3.11, and Scala 2.12.18, delivering performance and security improvements along with enhanced support for open table format libraries.

announcements.title: AWS Cost Optimization Hub now supports CSV download
announcements.summary: AWS Cost Optimization Hub now allows users to download cost optimization recommendations as CSV files directly from the console with a single click. This new feature exports recommendations based on your current console filters and settings, complementing the existing automated Data Export feature to Amazon S3. The capability enables quick local access to cost optimization data for further analysis and reporting.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal enhances PCoIP to DCV protocol migration
announcements.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal has improved its migration process from PCoIP to DCV protocol by adding a guided console interface, automatic checkpoint snapshots for rollback capability, and session blocking during the transition. The migration to DCV protocol provides customers with enhanced performance and expanded operating system support, including Windows 11 and Windows Server compatibility.

announcements.title: Amazon EC2 C8gn instances are now available in additional regions
announcements.summary: Amazon EC2 C8gn instances powered by AWS Graviton4 processors are now available in the Europe (Milan) and Asia Pacific (Hong Kong) regions. These new instances deliver up to 30% better compute performance compared to the previous Graviton3-based C7gn instances and feature 6th generation AWS Nitro Cards with up to 600 Gbps network bandwidth, the highest among network-optimized EC2 instances.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect Talent for AI-powered hiring (now available in Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect Talent is now available in Preview as an AI-powered hiring solution that uses AI agents to conduct structured voice interviews, administer assessments, and score candidates consistently at scale. The service, built on Amazon's hiring expertise, allows candidates to interview 24/7 from any device while freeing recruiters to focus on strategic decisions rather than initial screening tasks.

announcements.title: Amazon Bedrock now offers OpenAI models, Codex, and Managed Agents (Limited Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon Bedrock is now offering OpenAI's latest models, Codex, and Managed Agents through a limited preview, marking an expansion of the AWS-OpenAI partnership. This integration brings OpenAI's advanced AI capabilities to AWS's trusted infrastructure, providing enterprises with powerful AI models while maintaining the security, operational maturity, and data governance required for production workloads. All three offerings are currently available in limited preview on the Amazon Bedrock platform.

announcements.title: AWS Announces Amazon Connect Decisions
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon Connect Decisions, an AI-powered solution that helps supply chain teams transition from reactive problem-solving to proactive operations management. The platform leverages Amazon's three decades of operational expertise and over 25 specialized supply chain tools, with AI teammates that adapt to businesses and learn from team decisions. The solution is designed for companies across retail, consumer packaged goods, automotive, and industrial manufacturing sectors.

announcements.title: Build custom applications using natural language in Amazon Quick (Preview)
announcements.summary: AWS has announced preview features for Amazon QuickSight that enable users to build custom web applications using natural language descriptions, eliminating the need for coding skills or developer resources. These applications can connect to live data sources, implement complex workflows, and include AI-powered features, allowing any user to create fully interactive tools in minutes simply by describing their requirements.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick now available as a desktop application for macOS and Windows (Preview)
announcements.summary: Amazon Quick, AWS's AI assistant, is now available as a preview desktop application for macOS and Windows, extending beyond browser-based access. The desktop version provides enhanced capabilities including direct access to local files, OS-level notifications, and native desktop controls. This allows Quick to better understand users' complete work context across files, calendar, communications, and applications directly from the desktop environment.

announcements.title: Amazon Quick expands integrations to include Google Workspace, Zoom, Airtable, and more
announcements.summary: Amazon Quick, AWS's AI assistant that transforms questions into actionable outcomes for teams, is expanding with 13 new built-in connectors including Google Workspace, Zoom, and Airtable. These integrations feature managed authentication for secure, one-click account connections without manual credential setup. Quick centralizes tools and data while learning team preferences to provide grounded, contextual answers and actions.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift Serverless AI-driven scaling is now the default for new workgroups
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift Serverless now uses AI-driven scaling as the default for all new workgroups, leveraging machine learning to predict compute needs and automatically adjust resources before queries queue. This enhancement delivers better price-performance without manual tuning and expands support to workloads starting from 8 RPU (down from 32 RPU), reducing entry costs for smaller workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon Redshift Serverless is now available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Melbourne) and Canada West (Calgary) regions
announcements.summary: Amazon Redshift Serverless is now generally available in the AWS Asia Pacific (Melbourne) and Canada West (Calgary) regions. This service allows users to run and scale analytics workloads without needing to provision or manage data warehouse clusters, automatically handling capacity scaling. The service enables data analysts, developers, and data scientists to quickly gain insights from their data in seconds.

announcements.title: AWS KMS now tracks last usage of all KMS keys
announcements.summary: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) now automatically tracks and displays the last cryptographic operation performed with KMS keys, showing the timestamp, operation type, and CloudTrail event ID through the console or API. This eliminates the need for manual log analysis and helps security administrators and compliance teams quickly assess key usage for security and compliance purposes.

announcements.title: Amazon Connect increases attachment file sizes and adds custom file types
announcements.summary: Amazon Connect has increased the maximum attachment file size from 20 MB to 100 MB for chat, cases, and tasks, while also allowing administrators to configure custom file extensions. This enhancement enables enterprise customers to share larger files like diagnostic bundles and log archives directly through chat, streamlining support processes and reducing communication overhead.

announcements.title: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS Single-AZ (HA) file systems are now available in 17 additional AWS commercial and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
announcements.summary: Amazon FSx for OpenZFS Single-AZ (HA) file systems have expanded to 17 additional AWS Regions across South America, Europe, Africa, Asia Pacific, and AWS GovCloud (US). This fully managed service provides cost-effective shared file storage with sub-millisecond latencies, multi-GB/s throughput, and advanced ZFS features like snapshots, data cloning, and compression.

announcements.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports G7e and r5d.16xlarge instances
announcements.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, AWS's purpose-built infrastructure for large-scale foundation model development and training, now supports G7e and r5d.16xlarge instances. G7e instances are powered by NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs, providing enhanced compute capabilities for AI/ML workloads. This expansion gives users more instance options within SageMaker HyperPod's resilient environment that features built-in fault tolerance and automated cluster recovery.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 M8in and M8ib instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 M8in and M8ib instances powered by custom sixth-generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors exclusive to AWS and featuring the latest AWS Nitro cards. These new instances deliver up to 43% higher performance compared to previous M6in and M6ib generations, with M8in instances providing 600 Gbps network bandwidth for network optimization and M8ib instances offering EBS optimization.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 R8in and R8ib instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched new memory-optimized EC2 instances - R8in (network optimized) and R8ib (EBS optimized) - powered by custom sixth-generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors exclusive to AWS. These instances feature the latest AWS Nitro cards and deliver up to 43% better performance compared to previous generation instances, with R8in providing 600 Gbps network bandwidth.

announcements.title: Introducing Amazon EC2 C8ine and M8ine instances
announcements.summary: AWS has launched Amazon EC2 C8ine and M8ine instances powered by custom sixth-generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors and AWS Nitro cards, available exclusively on AWS. These new instances deliver up to 43% higher performance compared to previous generation C6in and M6in instances, with up to 2.5 times better packet performance per vCPU for network-optimized workloads.

announcements.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal Supports Rocky 9, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, and Ubuntu 24.04
announcements.summary: AWS has announced new Linux bundles for Amazon WorkSpaces Personal, adding support for Rocky Linux 9, Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9, and Ubuntu 24.04. These updated bundles provide customers access to the latest enterprise-grade Linux operating systems and modern Linux packages available in these newer releases, while previous versions (Rocky Linux 8, RHEL 8, and Ubuntu 22.04) remain available.

announcements.title: AWS Lambda Provisioned Mode for Kafka event source mappings (ESMs) now available in AWS Asia Pacific (Taipei) and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
